Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand - Ravenna Home 2-Light Flush-Mount Ceiling Light with White Frosted Glass Shade, 5.1"H, Brushed Steel
Colors: Brushed Steel
14.3"W x 14.3"D x 5.1"H White frosted glass shade, metal base in a brushed-steel finish This classic flush-mount ceiling light with frosted glass shade and brushed-steel base adds sophistication to any room with vintage or classic decor. 2 60-watt E26 bulbs required. Bulbs not included. Assemble in 15-30 minutes For indoor use only.
